title: Cache Lab
subtitle: Find out why your prompt misses the cache, and what that costs you every turn.
explainer: A local model reuses its prompt cache only for as long as the prompt still matches from the very first token. Anything that changes between turns - a timestamp, a session id, a reordered chunk - forfeits the cache for everything after it. This lab sends each layout twice with a changed value and reports what the daemon actually kept.
systemPromptPlaceholder: Paste the system prompt you send every turn.

diagnosis.title: Diagnosis
diagnosis.clean: Nothing here looks like it changes between turns, so the whole prompt can stay cached.
diagnosis.found: Found {count} value(s) that change between turns.
diagnosis.forfeits: The earliest sits far enough forward that {share} of the prompt is re-evaluated every turn.
diagnosis.legend: Green is the prefix the cache can keep. Red is the first value that changes. Grey is everything forfeited because it sits after that value.

verdict.title: Measured result
verdict.body: Moving the changing values to the end saves {tokens} prompt tokens and {ms} of prefill every turn - {speedup}x faster.
verdict.footnote: Measured on your own daemon, never estimated. Each layout was sent twice with a changed value, and the second send is what is reported. Requires Ollama 0.33.3 or newer to report cache reuse.

rewrite.title: The rewrite that was measured
rewrite.body: {chars} characters of this layout stay identical when its values change - that is the prefix the cache holds on to.
